newsitem.title: FRANCE: Latest massacre caps Algeria's litany of bloodshed.
newsitem.headline: Latest massacre caps Algeria's litany of bloodshed.

text.p: Suspected Moslem rebels slaughtered 93 Algerian villagers overnight south of Algiers, the worst such attack on civilians caught in the five years of violence pitting government forces against Moslem guerrillas.
This is a list of the worst massacres.
November 3
- Some 20 Moslem rebels killed 10 women and three children, cutting their throats one by one in Douaouda village near Algiers, newspaper reports said.
November 5

- In a similar raid, Moslem guerrillas slaughtered 31 people in Sidi el Kebit villlage, 50 km (30 miles) south of Algiers, the government said. Among the dead was a newly-married man and his bride, and 10 other women.
November 12
- Twelve villagers, including four women and three children, killed by rebels in Douar Ben Salah, the authorities said.
November 13
- Eighteen villagers die in two raids in Medea province, 70 km (45 miles) south of Algiers, the government said.
December 5
- Moslem rebels kill 19 people in night raid at Benachour, 50 km (30 miles) south of Algiers, Algerian newspapers said.
January 4
- About 50 rebels, split in four groups, massacre 16 villagers in Ben Achour hamlet, 50 km (30 miles) south of the Algerian capital, Algerian newspapers said.
January 5
- Rebels kill 18 villagers in Douaouda hamlet, souhwest of Algiers, official statement said.
January 12
- Moslem guerrillas kill 14 villagers in Tabainat, in Blida province, 50 km (30 miles) south of Algiers, newspapers said.
January 14
- Nine bodies found in Djebel Koukou in Algiers and Bab Ali village, near Algiers, Algerian newspapers said.
January 19
- Moslem rebels kill 36 people in Sidi Abdelaziz village, 70 km (45 miles) south of Algiers, the authorities said.
January 23
- Rebels kill 15 villagers, including 10 women, in Ali Baba far community, south of Algiers, residents and newspapers said.
February 17
- About 30 guerrillas hack to death 33 villagers in Kerrach hamlet, 60 km (40 miles) south of Algiers --Algerian newspaper.
April 5
- Moslem guerrillas massacre all the 52 inhabitants of a hamlet in Medea province, 70 km (45 miles) south of Algiers, Algerian El Watan newspaper said.
April 11
- Rebels killed 22 people in Menaa village near Boufarik, 30 km (18 miles) south of Algiers, an official statement said.
April 13
- Rebels slaughter 30 villagers in Chebli area, 50 km (30 miles) south of Algiers, official statement said.
April 21-22
- Rebels knife and hack to death 93 villagers, including 43 women and young girls, and three children, in Bougara area, says government.
